product.description: The Luminex Aura 60W Smart LED Bulb offers a versatile lighting solution for modern homes. Designed with a sleek polycarbonate housing and a high‑brightness LED array, it delivers up to 800 lumens of warm white light while consuming only 60 watts of power. The bulb features built‑in Wi‑Fi connectivity, allowing remote control via a dedicated app or voice assistants. It supports the standard E27 socket and includes a 2.4GHz Wi‑Fi band for reliable communication. Energy‑efficient operation, adjustable brightness, and a 24‑month warranty make it suitable for both residential and small commercial settings.
